item: Parks Canada Discovery Pass or daily entry
applies_to: All national parks (Banff, Yoho, Kootenay, Jasper, Waterton)
opens_2026_pattern: No booking window; buy any time online or at gate. Fees rose 1 Jan 2026.
cost_cad_2026: Annual adult $83.50, senior $71.50, family/group $167.50. Daily adult $12.25, senior $10.75, family $24.50 (up to 7 per vehicle). Youth 0-17 free (2026, secondary sources).
deadline_note: INFERENCE 2029: buy at first park gate or online before trip; next scheduled increase reported 1 Jan 2028, so 2029 prices will be at or above 2026. For a 2-week trip across 4 parks the annual family pass is likely cheaper than daily passes.

item: Canada Strong Pass (free park admission promotion)
opens_2026_pattern: Ran 19 Jun - 7 Sep 2026; free admission and 25% off camping/roofed accommodation (summaries).
cost_cad_2026: Free admission in window; parking, reservations, hot springs entry not covered.
deadline_note: INFERENCE 2029: do not rely on it; no information on 2027-2029 editions (GAP). 2026 window ended on Labour Day.

item: Parks Canada Lake Louise / Moraine Lake shuttle (incl. Lake Connector, Alpine Start)
applies_to: Lake Louise and Moraine Lake (Banff NP)
opens_2026_pattern: Wed 15 Apr 2026 08:00 MDT: 40% of seats released; remaining 60% released 08:00 MDT two days before each departure.
sells_out_note: Reported ~40,000 seats booked on launch day 2026 (search title only); usually sold out; waits 30-60 min. September-specific sell-out: GAP.
cost_cad_2026: Shuttle seat adult $12.75, senior $6, youth $4 (Banff Blog); plus booking fee $3.50 online or $5.50 phone (Parks Canada). Entry fee extra.
deadline_note: INFERENCE 2029: launch about mid-April 2029; book the Moraine/Lake Louise days on launch day; be ready for the 08:00 two-days-ahead release for any day missed. Season ends about Thanksgiving (8 Oct 2029), so 1-15 Sep is in season.
refund_note: Change or cancel $3.50 online / $5.50 phone up to 1 hour before departure window; booking fee non-refundable; fare refund: GAP.

item: Moraine Lake Road private vehicle ban and commercial/Roam options
provider: Parks Canada; Roam Transit; licensed commercial operators
opens_2026_pattern: Road closed to personal vehicles year-round; commercial list at CarFreeBanff.ca; Roam Reservable Super Pass is the only Roam fare for Lake Connector.
sells_out_note: Roam and commercial seats not documented (GAP).
cost_cad_2026: Roam Reservable Super Pass one-day $30; Moraine Lake Bus Company from $49 (Banff Blog).
deadline_note: INFERENCE 2029: have the Parks Canada shuttle reservation as primary and a commercial backup priced; the Banff-Lake Louise Roam 8X runs year-round.

item: Lake Louise Lakeshore parking and Park and Ride
opens_2026_pattern: Park and Ride free for shuttle reservation holders; Lakeshore lot paid, fills before sunrise; about 75% of vehicles turned away in summer 2025.
cost_cad_2026: Alpine Start Lakeshore parking $36.75 (Banff Blog); other rate not listed.
deadline_note: INFERENCE 2029: do not plan to drive to the Lakeshore lot; use shuttle.
